newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower in bearish trade after T-bill sales.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower in bearish trade after T-bill sales.

text.p: The rouble eased in bearish trading on Thursday as banks invested funds left over after Wednesday's Treasury bill sales in dollars, dealers said.
On Wednesday, the central bank auctioned 7.5 trillion roubles ($1.3 billion) of one-year paper and 4.5 trillion roubles of three-month bills.
roubles/dollar Feb 27 midday Feb 27 early Feb 26 close
"Roubles came back to the market after the auctions, and speculative (dollar) buying started. Nobody needs roubles badly so, the dollar is going up," one dealer said.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said "it is normal situation for post-auction days, with the market getting stable by the weekend."
